content: हरित् {%a.%} [हृ-इति] .²1 Green, greenish. .²2 Yellow, yellowish. .²3 Greenish-yellow. --{%m.%} .²1 The green or yellow colour. .²2 A horse of the sun, a bay horse; सत्यमतीत्य हरितो हरींश्च वर्तन्ते वाजिनः <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; दिशो हरिद्भिर्हरितामिवेश्वरः <ls>R. 3. 30</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 43</ls>. .²3 A swift horse. .²4 A lion. .²5 The sun. .²6 Viṣṇu. .²7 The kidney-bean. --{%m., n.%} .²1 Grass. .²2 A quarter, region. .²3 A quarter or point of the compass; प्रायात् प्रतीचीं हरितं विचिन्वंश्च ततस्ततः <ls>Rām. 7. 75. 10</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 30</ls>. .²4 Turmeric (usually {%f.%} only in the last 3 senses).
